title: fix(cron): reject on-exit cwd on stream metadata edits
body:
Fixes #198587

## What Problem This Solves

A stream metadata edit can succeed while silently ignoring an incompatible --on-exit-cwd flag.

## User Impact

The CLI reports the invalid flag combination before it updates the automation.

## Why This Change Was Made

Validate the option pair during schedule normalization, before the stream metadata branch can return.

## Evidence

- Ran the real Commander cron edit registration with --stream-cwd /new-stream --on-exit-cwd /watch against an existing stream-job RPC fixture. At 52e231b70 the command resolved successfully. With the fix it reports --on-exit-cwd requires --on-exit, exits with code 1, and makes no Gateway RPC.
- 126 tests passed across trigger-options.test.ts, schedule-options.onexit.test.ts and schedule-options.positional.test.ts. Focused oxfmt and oxlint checks passed.
- The Gateway boundary was stubbed. No external service was used. Reviewed the schedule call sites locally. Standalone autoreview was unavailable.
